name: Docker
requirements: Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, RHEL-family. Needs internet access.
description: Docker is a platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in containers.
script:
set -e
if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Docker is already installed"
    docker --version
    exit 0
fi
curl -fsSL https://docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh
sh /tmp/get-docker.sh
docker --version
